[P2] Return the proof-output option to the design phase

`PYTHON_CASE25_PROOF_DIR` introduces configurable artifact output and a separate reporting mechanism. The description contains no design note for this option, no consideration of simpler existing pytest output, and no explanation of the artifact-output decision. This breaks rule 2 (“Simplify before you add”), rule 3 (“Write a design note before the code”), and rule 7's decision-disclosure requirement. Return to the design phase under rule 8; prefer existing pytest diagnostics and temporary output unless configurable export has an agreed requirement.
